messages:
marie: Quick check — do we have a clear minimum TLS version requirement for service-to-service traffic? Seeing a few client entries in logs with TLSv1.2 and want to confirm policy before we approve any infra changes. Also: who owns control-plane KMS key rotation (policy vs execution)? Can infra run the next rotation if sec signs off?

ajay: For public-facing endpoints we require >= TLS1.2, but we standardized on TLS1.3 for runtime-to-runtime last quarter. Which logs are you seeing (LB, app, or control-plane)? If it's LB access logs, those sometimes still show TLS 1.2 from legacy pools. Example snippet I saw: `client_protocol: TLSv1.2, cipher: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256`

sam: Most prod clusters have a ConfigMap `tls-min-version: 1.3` now. Control-plane KMS: security sets the key policy and rotation cadence; infra executes the rotation steps. We usually require sec approval for the window and infra runs the playbook. I can help coordinate.

marie: The entries looked like LB access logs from 03/02 (small sample). Concerned logs are leaking SNI & TLS version. Policy says we should not store SNI/client cert details in logs. @dan can you confirm whether our redaction rules cover LB logs?

dan: LB streaming pipeline strips SNI for external traffic, but our internal LB access logs pipeline was missed in the last rollout. I'll add a rule for the LB logs. Pushed a PR to infra: #472. Redaction rule (inline):

```
# simple redaction regex used in the pipeline
sni_regex = r"(?<=sni=)[^ ]+"
redaction = "REDACTED_SNI"
```

It will replace SNI tokens and also drop client_cert fields.

ajay: KMS ownership note: security maintains key policies and rotation cadence (every 180 days). Infra gets short-term operational access for rotations via an ephemeral role. I can approve infra to run this rotation if they post the exact playbook and rollback steps here.

rotations-bot: Ticket created — ROT-1189 by ajay. Scheduled rotation window: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Participants: infra, security. Link: https://tickets.internal/ROT-1189

marie: I approve infra to run the rotation for that window, provided we do a canary and have fallback for 10 minutes with handshake-failure alerting. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 20m, then 50% for 30m, then full. If handshake failures >1% for 5m, rollback immediately.

sam: Will implement canary + fallback; we store previous cert in Vault and have an automated rollback step. I'll add the details to the rotation runbook and the ticket.

dan: I'll add a Prometheus alert: `expr = tls_handshake_failures_total / tls_handshakes_total > 0.01` for 5m -> page oncall. Also updating the logging pipeline to redact SNI for LB logs before retention.

marie: :thumbsup: Please post the PRs and the runbook link here once available and I'll mark the rotation approved. Also confirm that legacy dev pools are being drained or updated so no more TLS1.2 traffic.

ajay: PRs queued: infra#472 (logging redaction), infra#489 (KMS ephemeral role perms), ops#501 (rotation playbook).

sam: Runbook link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/rotation-runbooks/ctrl-plane-kms — I'll add canary steps and the rollback checklist in the next hour.

marie: Copy. Thanks everyone, closing the loop on this thread.
